tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops; agent-browser --session $S eval '(async()=>{let r=[];for(let p=1;p<=30;p++){let t=await fetch("/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops?page="+p);if(!t.ok)break;let d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await t.text(),"text/html");let c=d.querySelectorAll(".product-wrapper, .thumbnail");if(!c.length)break;c.forEach(e=>{let pr=e.querySelector(".price");let n=e.querySelector(".title");if(pr&&n)r.push([parseFloat(pr.textContent.replace("$","")),n.title||n.textContent,p])})}r.sort((a,b)=>b[0]-a[0]);return JSON.stringify({n:r.length,top:r.slice(0,3)})})()'
